. Credit markets will play a pivotal role. JPMorgan forecasts high-grade corporate debt will account for more than $2.1 trillion in data center financing over five years. In 2026, the bank anticipates $150 billion in U.S. hyperscaler issuance and another $100 billion equivalent abroad. Additional financing—about $170 billion—is expected from data center and chip issuers outside the core high-grade market, though alternative channels will remain relatively small. For JPMorgan, the conclusion is clear: AI-driven capital spending is scaling rapidly, and the economics are holding, for now. It will still be closely watched whether adoption will keep pace with the trillions being invested.
